subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should Feishu startup keep the current sequential 30s bot-info preflight, or should the plugin move bot identity probing to a shorter or background startup policy?
rationale: Changing this path can improve startup latency, but it affects Feishu mention gating, auth readiness, transport startup ordering, and connection health semantics.

options.title: Owner-reviewed startup repair
options.body: Shorten or background the Feishu startup probe with tests and live Feishu CN websocket proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep conservative preflight
options.body: Preserve the current 30s sequential probe policy and document the known startup tradeoff or supported timeout override.

options.title: Narrow to proxy-specific work
options.body: If live reproduction shows the timeout only happens behind HTTP/HTTPS proxy configuration, route the remaining startup fix through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386 or its canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Owner-reviewed startup repair
recommendation.body: Shorten or background the Feishu startup probe with tests and live Feishu CN websocket proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names m1heng as the Feishu plugin community maintainer, making them the best available owner for startup policy tradeoffs.
